units: <cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:1">Pes. III, 1</cite> <he>ח׳ האדומי</he> Edomite (Roman) vinegar (wine fermented with barley).

Ib. 42ᵇ (when the wine of Judæa could only be soured by an admixture of barley) היו קורין אותו ח׳ סתם וכ׳ they called it plain vinegar, and now … they call it Edomite (Roman, Cæsarean) vinegar (to distinguish it from pure vine vinegar).
<cite ref="Mishnah Demai 1:1">Dem. I, 1</cite> <he>הח׳ שביהודה</he> the vinegar made in Judæa, v. supra.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Shabbat 14:4:2">Y. Sabb. XIV, 14ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>חוֹמְצָן של פירות</he> fruit-vinegar; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 83b:9">B. Mets. 83ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בן יין</he> vinegar son of wine (bad son of a good father).
